label: 3. Commander, I was hoping you could help me with…

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Commander, I was hoping you could help me with something.
What is it?

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: How can I work more efficiently?
More so than you are right now?

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Precisely.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I want to work more efficiently than I do at the present.
You can't.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Why not?
You'll just end up wearing yourself down.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: No, I won't.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: If I work more efficiently,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I'll spend less time working.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Ergo, I'll have more time to rest.
You're lying.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Yes,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I was lying.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: However,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: greater efficiency does mean I could get more work done.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Who knows, if I keep working like this

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I may just reach the point where there isn't any room for improvement one day.
You don't actually think that's possible, do you?

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Sorry,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: you got me again.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: You're right.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: There is no end when it comes to self-improvement.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Rather, it's like a train on an endless loop.
In that case, you should pump the brakes.
Just keep things as they are.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: How can I slow down?

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: The moment I take a break,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: work will start to pile up.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: All this talk of taking it easy... That's crazy talk!

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Slowing down is not an option.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Regardless, thank you for your concern.
How about you don't change anything and just keep on truckin'?

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Keep things as they are, you say?

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I suppose you're right.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: If the track I'm on has no end,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I need to be careful not to overexert myself.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Perhaps that's the best course of action.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Thank you for the advice.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: My mind's a bit scrambled from all this work lately.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I'll just "keep on truckin," as you say.
Good luck.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Thank you, Commander.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: You too.
